notes_for_editor: The brief's status 'gone' conflicts with all the Valley County sources: Idaho Fire Lookouts and the state list say abandoned, and firelookout.com says the platforms are still there. The story keeps 'abandoned' and reports the still-there note as unconfirmed; a recent visit or source would settle it. The built event has no year because the sources give only the 1930s. The other cabin page calls it a Nez Perce cabin in its text but names the Clearwater National Forest on its forest line, and the story follows the forest line. Do not merge with the other Savage Ridge (Clearwater National Forest cabin, Idaho County, destroyed 1972, coordinates 46.45719, -114.58843 in the state list). Idaho Fire Lookouts has no documented staffing for this site, so staffing is left out.
